beats.say: Harry Potter's HBO series has finally cast the character Charlie Weasley.
The show premieres on 25 December, which is just 59 days away.
That is shorter than a single school term for most students.
Variety reports that Charlie Weasley will make his screen debut in this series.
Harry Gilby takes the role of the dragonologist, who never appeared in the films.
Jasper Talbot and Hannah Chinn are also joining as James and Lily Potter.
This casting means the TV adaptation is exploring deeper book details than the movies.
It all begins when the Harry Potter's HBO series has finally cast the character Charlie Weasley.
